content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Camilo Vance's PostCamilo VanceMarch 18 at 8:18 AM · Shared with Public“Former NBA star Lamar Odom is now the owner of three drug rehab centers in California.” This is what transformation looks like.Lamar Odom has turned his personal struggles into purpose—now using his journey to help others find healing, recovery, and a second chance at life. That’s powerful.It takes strength to overcome… but it takes even more to come back and uplift others walking the same path. This isn’t just business—it’s impact. It’s redemption. It’s giving hope to people who need it most.
